description: This file defines the I18NLanguageAPI class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing internationalization (i18n) language data within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods to list, retrieve, update, and delete languages, utilizing various traits, validators, and data models related to I18N language management.

classes.name: I18NLanguageAPI
classes.description: A REST API endpoint class for managing internationalization languages, including listing, retrieving, updating, and deleting language records within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.description: Handles the GET request to list all i18n languages with optional filters, sorting, and pagination.
